purpose: Diagnose whether the 857/858 time-coherent BBMM gap-cut masks obtained from naive Mountain wall-clock seconds are sensitive to daylight-saving-time and repeated local hours; no 2h holdout, geometry or EOG scoring.

common_eligibility.within_group_order: prior T0 ascending lower/upper original DBF row ordinal, fixed for all cases
common_eligibility.coherent_segmentation: longest feasible prefix then cut before first infeasible observation, restart with that observation's original allowed time set

alternative_time_interpretations.meaning: previous local naive wall-clock seconds; not UTC
all source local times treated as fixed UTC-07, negative control; should yield EXACT same gap-cut masks as local naive
conditional civil Mountain time with actual historical IANA America/Denver DST offset changes and both legal folds of repeated local exact hour

observation_time_domains.T0_FULL_DAY_UNCERTAINTY: date-only any local civil second 00:00:00–23:59:59 inclusive
observation_time_domains.T1_PUBLISHED_NEAR_MIDNIGHT_WINDOW: date-only any local civil second 00:00:00–01:00:00 inclusive
observation_time_domains.full: exact given local wall second, but on a fall-back ambiguous repeated hour preserve all distinct valid IANA fold instants; skip nonexistent civil time if any, report an explicit STOP
observation_time_domains.conversion: For a full civil-day date under America/Denver, UTC interval from local midnight to following local midnight minus 1s; for T1 near-midnight on fall-back day, represent 00:00–01:00 (first-fold) plus additional 01:00 second-fold singleton, NOT convex hull across the excluded hour; for exact fold ambiguity use disjoint UTC singleton alternatives
observation_time_domains.confidence: IANA TZ does not establish whether original publisher stored DST-aware civil time; this is an explicit sensitivity, not an imputation

numerical_method: Keep each allowed timestamp as sorted non-overlapping closed UTC integer-second interval(s). From each reachable [a,b], one positive 1..45000s transition reaches [a+1,b+45000]. Union and intersect with the next observation's allowed intervals; merge overlapping or adjacent seconds only. No synthetic merging across gaps. Cut and reset when intersection empty.
report: counts of exact-time source records with ambiguous DST fold and nonexistent local times; count date-only source records on fall-back and spring transition local dates
coherent cut count for T0 and T1 under all three temporal interpretations
paired exact link cut overlaps between original NAIVE and FIXED_MST, and between NAIVE and AMERICA_DENVER: common, naive-only, Denver-only, both kept, and affected-group count
pairwise-optimistic link counts and extra coherent cuts under the IANA world, for both T0 and T1
no individual IDs/coordinates/exact times/source UTC values or time-window examples
controls: FIXED MST must have exactly identical coherent cut masks as NAIVE under both clock scenarios
NAIVE must reproduce 857 T0 and 858 T1 cuts and 857 common
A directed pair alone agrees with union interval propagation; difference only due to inter-record coherent assignments
independent small union-interval brute-force integer time enumeration with multiple disjoint legal instants
IANA results may differ; preserve as conditional sensitivity, not proof of actual observation timestamp conversion
fail closed on source checksum mismatch, unrecognized time shape, unknown IANA zone or nonexistent exact local wall time
prohibitions: no 2hour dense GPS, no SHP geometry, no coordinate or herd-level output, no original source ZIP in GitHub, no EOG prediction or BBMM fit, no silent true-CRS correction, no retrofit of previous frozen results
